sections.content: I am [A_LICENSE_TYPE] in [LICENSE_STATE_PHRASE] (License No. [LICENSE_NUMBER]). I have provided mental health treatment to [CLIENT_FULL_NAME], a student at [INSTITUTION_NAME], since [ACCOM_START_DATE][TREATMENT_LENGTH_PAREN]. I am writing at [CLIENT_FIRST_NAME]’s request to support their request for academic accommodations.

[CLIENT_FIRST_NAME] has been diagnosed with [DIAGNOSIS_LIST]. This condition is a disability under Section 504 of the Rehabilitation Act of 1973 and the Americans with Disabilities Act, as amended by the ADA Amendments Act of 2008 (ADAAA), because it substantially limits one or more major life activities.

[CLIENT_FIRST_NAME] has a condition that I am treating, which may qualify as a disability under Section 504 of the Rehabilitation Act of 1973 and the Americans with Disabilities Act, as amended by the ADA Amendments Act of 2008 (ADAAA). At their request, specific diagnostic information is not included in this letter.
Based on the functional impact I have observed, I recommend the following accommodations:

These recommendations follow the Association on Higher Education and Disability (AHEAD) guidance that documentation describe how a condition affects the student and how each accommodation addresses that impact. Final accommodation decisions rest with [INSTITUTION_NAME]’s disability services office.

[CLIENT_FIRST_NAME] is a capable student. These accommodations are meant to remove barriers so they can demonstrate their knowledge and skills, and they understand their responsibility to communicate with their instructors about these accommodations in a timely manner.
